message: 日常にある感謝
Today, we decided to make costumes so everyone could have fun at the Holy Night Festival.

name: Nanaka
message: 「The folks in the shopping district gave us a whole bunch of fabric!」

name: Ria
message: 「We asked the handicrafts club to handle the fancy stuff, so let's make the simple ones ourselves~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「As long as I have my Blackuma mascot suit, I'm fine...\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What are you planning to do with my body...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Isn't Lolotte here yet?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, there she is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Grandfather and Grandmother sent over a whole lot for us~」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing! There's tons of it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, actually, this isn't all of it, you know.\s07」
Azel was carrying luggage behind Lolotte.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, you came too.」

name: Azel
message: 「I make it a rule, to repay, my debts.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're not the Vice President, so it's okay to be a little more honest with yourself, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why am I being brought into this?!」

name: Sally
message: 「What's this, what's this~? What are you doing~?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone is about to make costumes for the costume party. Would you like to join us too, Ms. Extra?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, I'm in, I'm in~!」
And so the sewing session began.

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh~~ You're pretty handy, Lolotte-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. Ever since the President taught me, I've been making rapid progress, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's knitting, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha-wha...!? Behind my back, the two of you were doing something like that...」

name: Sally
message: 「If Lolo-chi can do it, I bet I can too. All right, let's give it a shot♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. I wonder about that~~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa! I have no idea what I'm doing!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jeez~~ You're hopeless. Allow me to coach you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Urgh~. It kinda ticks me off, but help me out, Lolo-chi!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave it to me!」
Lolotte set out to instruct Sally-chan, however...

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, if you pass the needle through like this, it should work out nicely.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooooh. I see, you're so smart, Lolo-chi~~」
For some reason, the needle poked right into her tail. How on earth do you stab yourself there.

name: Sally
message: 「Eek, what is this, it hurts!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Whoa! Please don't thrash around~~」

name: Sally
message: 「Gyaaah, if it hurts this bad, you should've told me sooner!」
Saying that, Sally-chan flailed about wildly, so--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawuh!?」
Whenever Sally-chan gets involved, why does the pig always end up the victim.

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah! I'm sorrryyy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Urgh~~\s06」
The usual sight, everyone together in this heartwarming everyday life.
And on top of that--
Today, Azel is here too.
Lolotte is so happy about that, it feels like she's putting in even more effort than usual.

name: Azel
message: 「What am I supposed to do here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, for that part--」

name: Azel
message: 「I wasn't asking you.」
Ugh, what does that make my position...

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't speak to my master like that.」
Oh, she's already bounced back.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san, at this rate you're just playing around poking holes.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't get it. That's why I'm asking.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood! Leave it to me!」
Just like Sally-chan, Azel also receives a lesson from Lolotte.

name: Sally
message: 「Haha, you suck! Just like me!」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, you do this part like this--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah!」
And then, just like Sally-chan, she ends up pricking her finger with the needle.

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-Are you alright?」

name: Azel
message: 「About what?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No... It's just that there's a needle stuck in your finger...」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft... Look at her trying to tough it out!」
Without changing her expression, Azel continues the work just as Lolotte taught her.
And then, poke, once again.

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah! I can't watch this anymore!」

name: Azel
message: 「Then go do what you're supposed to be doing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh... um, doesn't that hurt?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's fine.」
Talk about having a high pain tolerance, or whatever you'd call it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel... san...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...?」
However, watching Azel work in silence, Lolotte was overcome by an unusual sense of impatience.
The work reached a stopping point, and the Student Council room was dismissed as is.

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you heading home yet, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I did arrive a little late, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」
Perhaps because she had gotten the hang of it and started enjoying herself, Lolotte kept on sewing with small excuses.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's about Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. It was great that she came. Hopefully she'll keep it up and come tomorrow too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! It really was wonderful~~」
For a brief moment her face lit up brightly, though a shadow quickly returned to her expression.
She had been like that all day today.
Something must have happened regarding Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「What's going on with Azel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today... you saw it too, didn't you, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean when she was helping out?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I was truly happy that Azel tried her best. However--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even when the needle pricked her, she didn't react at all, did she?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel's always expressionless, so I just figured that's how she is, though...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But you can feel it, can't you, President!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh! W-Well... of course, it hurts.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can feel it too... Normally, we're supposed to be able to feel it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This thing called pain.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, I--we angels only come to know 'pain' after coming to the Human World.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As spiritual beings, we are unable to know the sensation of pain.」

name: Synn
message: 「What...」
I had thought Azel's poor condition was a side effect of transitioning from spirit matter to physical matter.

name: Synn
message: 「You mean... she's reverting back to spirit matter while still in the Human World?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Presumably... That should be impossible. And yet...」
Just what on earth is happening to Azel?
With Lolotte's knowledge and mine, we can't pinpoint any new cause.

name: Synn
message: 「I really can't figure it out.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「We really can't figure this out on our own.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「But we have reliable friends we can count on.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it's about time I told everyone the truth. That I'm the Demon Lord.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President...」

name: Synn
message: 「And I want to ask for everyone's help. Don't you think if we do that, we'll be able to figure out more of what we don't understand?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「B-But... what if some of them have the wrong impression of you, just like Amyrina and I did?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so. Still, I can't keep hiding it any longer.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I understand. If that is your decision, then I would like to confess everything to everyone as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Let's do it together.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As long as you're with me, President, I... I won't be afraid!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuuh~~ I'm always relying on you for absolutely everything, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I do! It's because you don't realize that about yourself that everyone calls you dense!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, I won't be satisfied leaving things as they are! Just what should I do--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's it! Feelings of gratitude should be properly repaid!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?! You don't need to pay me back or anything.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no! Please let me thank you properly next time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Really, it's fine! Don't worry about it, don't worry about it.」
Just being able to help Lolotte makes me happy enough.
